bead.title: bench-pr-A2: shell harness-adapters + harbor task-executor + runtime-probe + CONTRACTs
bead.description:
PROBLEM: The matrix-side adapters are host Python (scripts/benchmark/harness_adapters/*.py) and Harbor is invoked in-process; both keep host Python mandatory. claude/codex are wired through Go at cmd/bench/matrix.go:1015-1025 passing --agent-import-path.

ROOT CAUSE: scripts/benchmark/harness_adapters/{fiz,opencode,pi,cost_probe,noop,dumb_script}.py run on the host interpreter, and the claude/codex install/command path is embedded in Go (cmd/bench/matrix.go:1015-1025). There is no shell adapter contract and no containerized task executor.

PROPOSED FIX:
- scripts/benchmark/harness-adapters/{fiz,claude,codex,opencode,pi,cost-probe,noop,dumb-script}: executable bash ports of the reference Python adapters. Each carries a `# SUMMARY:` header line and two subcommands: `<name> install <agent-artifact-path>` -> install-spec.json {install_command, artifact_source, binary_path, harbor_plugin} (harbor_plugin names the Harbor class, e.g. scripts.benchmark.harbor_adapters.fiz:FizeauAgent); `<name> command` (reads profile JSON on stdin) -> command-spec.json {command, env, secret_env_keys}.
- scripts/benchmark/task-executors/harbor: bash wrapper that runs `docker run --rm -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock -v "$cell_dir:/output" -v "$tasks_dir:/tasks:ro" -e FIZEAU_API_KEY -e FIZEAU_BASE_URL -e FIZEAU_MODEL ... fizeau-harbor-runner:latest run --agent-import-path "$harbor_plugin" --task-id "$task_id" --output /output ...`. Reads task-spec.json from stdin; writes cell_dir/result.json. Captures task_executor_version + harbor_runner_image_digest once per ./benchmark invocation into <out>/sweep.json.
- scripts/benchmark/runtime-probe.sh: case on profile.metadata.runtime with one arm each for lucebox, llamacpp, vllm, omlx, ds4, rapid-mlx; curl + jq the runtime HTTP endpoint; emit model_server JSON {name, version, commit, endpoint}.
- scripts/benchmark/task-executors/CONTRACT.md and scripts/benchmark/harness-adapters/CONTRACT.md document the JSON shapes and the `# SUMMARY:` convention.

NON-SCOPE: sampling.planning_mode handling inside the fiz adapter (added in A5 with the agent-leak fix); the runner/dispatch (A3); concurrency/budget (A4); Go changes/parity/deactivation (A5); plus all parent out-of-scope items: cell-report.schema.json (PR B), tasks_from/task_executor schema (PR C), Node collector (PR D), Node importers (PR E), deleting cmd/bench (PR F), docs (PR G).

GOVERNING ARTIFACT: plan-2026-05-15-benchmark-runner-simplification.

DEPENDENCIES: A1 (harbor task-executor needs fizeau-harbor-runner image). The Python adapters under scripts/benchmark/harness_adapters/ remain the reference for emitted fields.

ACCEPTANCE (numbered; Test* symbols in scripts/benchmark/tests/adapters.bats):
1. Test_each_adapter_has_summary_header: all 8 harness-adapters start with a `# SUMMARY:` line and are executable.
2. Test_fiz_command_spec_matches_python_reference: `harness-adapters/fiz command < profile.json` emits {command, env, secret_env_keys} equivalent to harness_adapters/fiz.py for the canary profile.
3. Test_install_spec_names_harbor_plugin: `harness-adapters/<name> install <artifact>` emits a non-empty harbor_plugin for fiz/claude/codex.
4. Test_harbor_executor_writes_result_json: `task-executors/harbor` given a task-spec.json on stdin runs the container and produces cell_dir/result.json.
5. Test_runtime_probe_all_backends: runtime-probe.sh emits valid model_server JSON for each of lucebox, llamacpp, vllm, omlx, ds4, rapid-mlx.
Gates: `lefthook run pre-commit` passes (shellcheck + bats); `go test ./...` passes.
bead.acceptance: Test_each_adapter_has_summary_header, Test_fiz_command_spec_matches_python_reference, Test_install_spec_names_harbor_plugin, Test_harbor_executor_writes_result_json, and Test_runtime_probe_all_backends pass; lefthook pre-commit and go test ./... pass.
